part_B_selected_column.conclusion: SEL-02: there is NO executable selected-column read. usecols is never supplied at any reader site. The warrant's allowed_operations.SELECTED_VARIABLE_PHYSICAL entries for SRC02/SRC06/SRC14 are DECLARATIVE CONTRACTS whose exactness is enforced by court assertions and the O1-C08 stop trigger on an absent variable, an absent ordinal or an UNEXPECTED selected column - not by a bounded read operation. A selected-read COUNT would guard an operation that does not exist, so no such count is created.
part_B_selected_column.what_is_real_and_governed: Selected-variable EXACTNESS is enforced, not a selected-read COUNT. That is a different account and is labelled as such, not relabelled into a read count.

part_C_header_prefix.contrast_with_compiled_reader: Unlike the pyreadstat reader, this read is pure Python and IS visible to builtins.open / Path.open interception. It is therefore governable.
part_C_header_prefix.operation_vs_byte_count: OPERATION COUNT = number of prefix reads performed (1 per SAV decode). BYTE COUNT = bytes returned by each (176 for SAV, 512 for DTA). These are distinct and are reported separately.

part_D_byte_accounting.explicit_law: Synthetic byte totals observed here are NOT predictions about real survey-file byte totals. No C3 byte ceiling is proposed for the compiled reader.
